examples.text: Pas touche, Nadia! Claire, voulez-vous rester comme responsable de la réception pour de bon?
examples.trans: Hands off, Nadia! Claire, would you stay as permanent front-desk manager?

meanings.en: to rehearse, to practise (a role, a play)

examples.text: Vingt millimètres, en laiton, vanne de chaudière: je vais répéter ça tout le long!
examples.trans: Twenty millimetres, brass, boiler valve: I am going to repeat that all the way!

meanings.note: Masculine noun ('le sac', plural 'les sacs') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'handbag'.

examples.text: Pose ton sac sur la table.
examples.trans: Put your bag on the table.

examples.text: Pour l'instant, son sac reste bien enfermé à clé.
examples.trans: For now, his bag stays safely locked up.

examples.text: Gardez mon sac bleu jusqu'à vendredi, s'il vous plaît.
examples.trans: Please keep my blue bag until Friday.

meanings.note: Reflexive clitic used with third-person subjects; s' before a suitable vowel sound.

examples.trans: Can you do me a favour?

meanings.note: pronounced si before a consonant: six jours = si ʒuʁ

examples.text: Non, Étienne, le couple du sud est arrivé dans la chambre six il y a une heure.
examples.trans: No, Etienne, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

related.word: pronounced si before a consonant: six jours

meanings.note: Agrees with the noun owned (son sac, sa valise, ses clés); used before feminine vowel-initial nouns too.

meanings.note: Feminine abstract noun formed with '-ité' (from Latin '-itas', English '-ity'). Standard feminine noun meaning 'stability, emotional security'.

examples.text: Je vérifie simplement la sécurité. C'est mon métier.
examples.trans: I am simply checking security. That is my job.

meanings.note: For a late time or doing something late.

meanings.en: à plus tard = see you later
meanings.note: With plus, later; à plus tard is the farewell see you later.

examples.text: Trop tard! Il a dit merci et il a raccroché!
examples.trans: Too late! He said thank you and hung up!

examples.text: Madame Odette, tout va bien? Vous avez sonné!
examples.trans: Madam Odette, is everything alright? You rang the bell!

meanings.note: prendre le train = to take the train
être en train de faire = to be in the middle of doing

examples.text: Oui, la chambre quatre au deuxième étage! Comment était votre voyage en train?
examples.trans: Yes, room four on the second floor! How was your train trip?

examples.text: Et qu'est-ce que c'est, dans ce papier blanc? Un petit train en bois!
examples.trans: And what is this, in this white paper? A little wooden train!

examples.text: Comme c'est étrange! Nous avons pris le même train ce matin pour le même quartier.
examples.trans: How strange! We rode the same train this morning to the same district.

meanings.note: se transformer complètement = to transform completely

examples.text: Des bureaux commerciaux?! Transformer notre hôtel et ma cuisine en bureaux gris?!
examples.trans: Commercial offices?! Turn our hotel and my kitchen into grey offices?!
To transform an idea into a project.

meanings.note: Contractions.
échanger des places = to swap places
Échanger avec qqn. Regular first-group '-er' verb (from Latin first conjugation '-are') meaning 'to exchange'; conjugates with 'avoir' in compound tenses (past participle 'échangé').

examples.text: Pur hasard, plus une valise bleue échangée dans le train de lundi matin!
examples.trans: Pure luck, plus one swapped blue suitcase on Monday morning's train!

examples.text: Je compose le numéro... Allô? Quelqu'un a signalé une valise bleue échangée?
examples.trans: I am dialling the number... Hello? Did anyone report a swapped blue suitcase?

meanings.note: irregular verb; past participle: écrit

examples.text: Il veut écrire, diriger, choisir ses partenaires.
examples.trans: He wants to write, direct, choose his partners.
She is writing a new script.

meanings.note: Feminine noun ('la écriture', plural 'les écritures') inherited through Romance vocabulary, used in everyday and professional French for 'writing'.

examples.text: Comme c'est curieux! L'écriture sur l'étiquette me semblait familière.
examples.trans: How curious! The handwriting on the tag seemed familiar to me.

meanings.note: De petites étoiles = little stars.
Une étoile du cinéma.

examples.text: Il va écrire un avis terrible d'une étoile!
examples.trans: He is going to write a terrible one-star review!
